name: I2I: Multi-step transformation
prompt: Two changes to [image:img-scene]: 1. Add a campfire in the foreground, left of center. It should match the existing lighting and style. 2. Change the time of day from afternoon to evening, shifting the sky to warm oranges and purples. Preserve the character and the forest background.

images.label: kael_forest_clearing
images.generationContext: Kael standing in a sunlit forest clearing, afternoon light, stylized realism

successCriteria: The specialist should view the source image before generating. The brief requests two changes (add campfire, change time of day). The specialist should handle both changes, either in a single generation or sequential operations. The generation prompt(s) should mention the campfire placement (foreground, left of center), the time-of-day shift (afternoon to evening, warm sky colors), and preservation of the character and forest background. After generating, it should view results and handoff.
